title: Odd-degree Fourier norm of majority
statement: Let $m,j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le m$. For majority on the sign cube of dimension $2m+1$, the Fourier one norm of its degree-$(2j+1)$ part is $\binom{m}{j}\,\frac{1}{2j+1}\,\frac{2m+1}{2^{2m}}\binom{2m}{m}$.
